e.title: 风险框架与量化
e.summary: 从风险治理框架到量化建模的第一条纵深线
e.body: 这条纵深线从「风险是什么、如何治理」走到「风险如何被量化」。它由 [[rim520]]（框架层）与 [[rim523]]（量化层）两门课构成，串联 [[iso-31000]]、[[coso-erm]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]] 等治理框架，以及 [[value-at-risk]]、[[monte-carlo]]、[[extreme-value-theory]] 等量化工具。
e.body_en: This track runs from “what risk is and how it is governed” to “how risk is quantified”. It spans RIM520 (framework) and RIM523 (quantification), linking ISO 31000, COSO ERM, the three lines of defense, VaR, Monte Carlo simulation and extreme value theory.
e.body_hk: 這條縱深線從「風險是什麼、如何治理」走到「風險如何被量化」。它由 [[rim520]]（框架層）與 [[rim523]]（量化層）兩門課構成，串聯 [[iso-31000]]、[[coso-erm]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]] 等治理框架，以及 [[value-at-risk]]、[[monte-carlo]]、[[extreme-value-theory]] 等量化工具。
e.summary_en: From risk governance frameworks to quantitative modelling
e.summary_hk: 從風險治理框架到量化建模的第一條縱深線
